name: mobile-tab-shell
title: Mobile tab shell
description: A phone-first app frame: a top bar with title and back, scrolling content and a bottom tab bar that respects the home indicator.
docs: Give it a title, three to five tabs ({ id, label, icon, badge }) and the id of the active one. Tabs are real links with aria-current: pass onTabChange to switch screens in state, or leave it out and give each tab an href. The title is large at the top of the content and moves into the app bar once it has scrolled out of view; onBack adds a back button, actions fills the right of the bar, fab floats a round button above the tab bar. The content scrolls on its own with overscroll-contain and ends where the tab bar begins. screenKey (default the active tab) says when the screen has changed: the content then starts at the top and fades in, and the new title takes focus so the change is announced (never on the first render, and not when a tab was pressed, which keeps its focus). The bar clears the notch and the home indicator with env(safe-area-inset-*). From md up the screen is 390px wide and centred; pass a height in className to size it.
